censoring.policy: retain observed elapsed time; never relabel as convergence

hardware_sensitive_outputs: wall, mutation, checker, and decision-tree durations
logical_outputs: status, verdicts, decided candidate sets, trees, confusion matrices, and counts are reproducible outputs

performance_rerun_tolerance.applies_to: experiment-level median phase and total times
performance_rerun_tolerance.conditions: same CPU model, allocation, checker/tool versions, and exclusive/uncontended scheduling
performance_rerun_tolerance.interpretation: outside tolerance requires investigation; it does not invalidate logical reproduction
